headline: Contra somersaults
lede: The arcade's most recognizable jump — a full forward roll through the air — now lives on the shelf. The hero tumbles one complete turn per jump while the gun arm holds its aim, and every stored physics pin stood byte-for-byte.

notes.text: #3035 shipped: the cabinet rolls the hero a full revolution through every jump (37-tick arc, pinned to the observed physics); a ledge step-off or press-through rides upright, so the tumble keeps meaning 'I jumped' — and the blue wingman rolls under the same seatStep law.

Presentation provably outside the referee: rollT never enters stateHash and never draws gs.r — states differing only in the roll hash identically, the 12-seed autopilot sweep and every replay twin stood unchanged; named mutants stiff-hop and roll-on-step die by name (mutant run 189/189).

Headless Chrome paints at ~12 fps here, so single-hop pixel assertions are dicey — the new leg samples four hops and proves the held-aim barrel by MEAN difference between same-seed arm-states; steel predicates must be cold-blue-leading, since jungle dark-greens answer naive 'dark' tests. Also: #3030 (forge-merge second shape) bit again and the law held — PR state said MERGED, cleanup finished by hand.

look.text: Contra, now with the forward roll: tap in and hold a jump at the first tree.
Minesweeper's press-feel shipped beside it this morning — sink, preview, co…
